## From Metadata to Agents: Building AI-Powered Data Workflows with OpenMetadata {.center}

## About Our Presenter 

- [Erfan Hesami](https://www.linkedin.com/in/erfanhesami/) is a Senior Data Engineer / Architect who has worked with companies such as Allianz, Xero, AFL, and Airmaster, helping teams better use their data.

- He started his career as a Data Analyst, then moved into Analytics Engineering, and now focuses on building data platforms and systems.

- Erfan enjoys sharing what he learns about data engineering and AI through simple, practical content on his Substack, [_Pipeline to Insights_](https://substack.com/@pipeline2insights), helping others grow in their careers.
